overview: This is an improved, widecreen version of Antonio Margheriti's "Battle of the Worlds" ("Il pianeta degli uomini spenti") starring Claude Rains. Manson Distributing Topaz Film Corporation Release dates October 30, 1961 (Italy) March 1963 (United States) Running time 84 minutes Country Italy Language Italian Battle of the Worlds ( Italian : Il Pianeta degli uomini spenti ) is a 1961 Italian science fiction film directed by Antonio Margheriti , starring Claude Rains , Bill Carter and Maya Brent. The Italian title translates as The Planet of Extinct Men . [1]
